preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access onlyOwner functions (setPercentageOfLiquidityForMarketing, setMaxWalletTokens, setMarketingWallet)

exploit_hint: As owner: 1) Call setMarketingWallet(attacker_address) to set marketing wallet to attacker's address. 2) Call setPercentageOfLiquidityForMarketing(200) to set marketing fee percentage >100%. 3) Trigger swapAndLiquify by having users transfer tokens (tokens accumulate in contract balance). 4) When swapAndLiquify executes, it swaps half the tokens for BNB and sends marketingFee = newBalance * 200 / 100 to attacker's wallet, extracting more BNB than was generated. Alternatively, call setMaxWalletTokens(0) to block all user transfers while owner retains ability to trade freely.
